speaker: Chuck
text: Gotta win the battle in the trenches here.

speaker: Chuck
text: Watch the first ten seconds. That sets the tone.

speaker: Chuck
text: Game faces on! Let's see what they got!

speaker: Dale
text: And here's our rookie team. Bless their hearts.

speaker: Dale
text: The rookies built this in a garage. You can tell.

speaker: Dale
text: First time in the Box. No pressure. Only everybody watching.

speaker: Dale
text: Rookies! Everybody be nice. For now.

speaker: Dale
text: I love a rookie. So much hope. So many loose bolts.

speaker: Chuck
text: Love this rookie team. Hungry. Raw talent.

speaker: Chuck
text: First time in the Box! Welcome to the big leagues!

speaker: Chuck
text: The rookie's got heart, Dale. You can't coach heart.

speaker: Chuck
text: Rookie season! I remember mine. I threw four interceptions.

speaker: Chuck
text: Give this rookie a chance. They might surprise you.

speaker: Dale
text: Welcome to BotBox. I'm Dale Pruitt, and yes, this is my real job.

speaker: Dale
text: Good evening. I'm Dale Pruitt. Tonight, robots fight and I make jokes about it.

speaker: Dale
text: Welcome back to the Box. With me as always, the Cannon himself, Chuck Kowalski.

speaker: Dale
text: Hi, I'm Dale. My mom thinks I host a cooking show.

speaker: Dale
text: Tonight's robots have saws, hammers and flamethrowers. Well, no flamethrowers. Yet.

speaker: Chuck
text: Dale, I have been waiting all week for this!

speaker: Chuck
text: Chuck Kowalski here, and Dale, I am fired up!

speaker: Chuck
text: These robots came to play tonight, Dale. I can feel it.

speaker: Chuck
text: Big night, Dale. Big night. I barely slept.

speaker: Chuck
text: I watched film on every one of these robots. Twice.

speaker: Dale
text: We'll be right back.

speaker: Dale
text: Don't go anywhere. BotBox will be right back.

speaker: Dale
text: Stick around. More robot violence after this.

speaker: Dale
text: We'll be right back, after a word from people with money.

speaker: Jenna
text: I'm down in the pits, where the rookie team is scrambling to get this thing ready!

speaker: Jenna
text: Hey Dale! I'm in the pits, and there are tools everywhere. Like, everywhere!

speaker: Jenna
text: I'm here with our rookies. They've got duct tape, a drill, and about four minutes!

speaker: Jenna
text: Down here in the pits, you can smell the solder! It is so exciting!

speaker: Jenna
text: I'm here with the winners! How does it feel?

speaker: Jenna
text: Oh my gosh, you guys did it! Tell me everything!

speaker: Jenna
text: What a fight! Was that the plan all along?

speaker: Jenna
text: Congratulations! Did you think you could win that one?

speaker: Jenna
text: Tough loss. What happened out there?

speaker: Jenna
text: Aw, I'm so sorry, guys. What went wrong?

speaker: Jenna
text: That was rough. Are you gonna rebuild?

speaker: Jenna
text: You fought hard out there. What's next for the team?

speaker: Jenna
text: This is it, the final! How are you feeling right now?

speaker: Jenna
text: One more fight for the Giant Nut! Are you nervous?

speaker: Jenna
text: It's the final, guys! Any last words before you go in?

speaker: Jenna
text: You did it! You won the Giant Nut! How does it feel?

speaker: Jenna
text: BotBox champions! Oh my gosh! Say something!

speaker: Jenna
text: Champions! Can you guys even lift that thing?

speaker: Vic
text: From Fresno, California, a two hundred and twenty pound wedge made from a door hinge and pure optimism... DOORSTOP!

speaker: Vic
text: From Stockton, California, a two hundred and twenty pound spiked rammer that eats whatever you leave lying around... TRASH PANDA!

speaker: Vic
text: From Modesto, California, a two hundred and twenty pound vertical spinner that wobbles like a shopping cart... LAWN DART!

speaker: Vic
text: From Sacramento, California, a beekeeper with a grudge and a two hundred and twenty pound horizontal spinner... BUZZ OFF!

speaker: Vic
text: From San Jose, California, a two hundred and twenty pound pneumatic axe. Number nine, extra spicy... CHOP SUEY!

speaker: Vic
text: From Boston, Massachusetts... undefeated. A titanium bar spinning at highway speed. The robot that ended a dynasty... TERMINAL VELOCITY!

speaker: Vic
text: DOORSTOP!

speaker: Vic
text: TRASH PANDA!

speaker: Vic
text: LAWN DART!

speaker: Vic
text: BUZZ OFF!

speaker: Vic
text: CHOP SUEY!

speaker: Vic
text: TERMINAL VELOCITY!

speaker: Vic
text: Forty five seconds left in the championship final! This house is ON ITS FEET, and the champ is ROLLING!

speaker: Vic
text: It's over! I don't believe it... Juggernaut is DOWN! It's OVER!

speaker: Vic
text: Ladies and gentlemen... the reign is over. Your NEW BotBox champion... TERMINAL VELOCITY!

speaker: Dale
text: Juggernaut is just toying with it now. This isn't a fight, it's a coronation.

speaker: Dale
text: Somebody start polishing the Giant Nut. Again.

speaker: Dale
text: Oh, that's mean. That's championship mean!

speaker: Chuck
text: That's a CHAMPION'S hit, Dale! That's why it's the champ!

speaker: Chuck
text: The champ's in victory formation! Just take a knee, baby!

speaker: Chuck
text: Put it in the trophy case! This dynasty is NOT done!

speaker: Dale
text: Wait. Wait, what is that bar doing?

speaker: Dale
text: Uh oh. That's not a spinner anymore. That's a jet engine.

speaker: Chuck
text: Hold on! Listen to that bar wind up! Look out, champ!

speaker: Chuck
text: It's coming! Juggernaut doesn't see it! LOOK OUT!

speaker: Dale
text: Oh no. Oh, no. It hit the ceiling. The champ hit the ceiling.

speaker: Dale
text: I... I don't have a joke. I don't have anything.

speaker: Chuck
text: OH! OH NO! The champ is upside down! It's on FIRE!

speaker: Chuck
text: That's not possible. Nobody hits the champ like that. Nobody.

speaker: Jenna
text: Stunner tonight: former champ Juggernaut crashes out in the first round.

speaker: Jenna
text: Two more sponsors walk away from Team Juggernaut.

speaker: Jenna
text: Juggernaut has dropped out of the rankings entirely.

speaker: Jenna
text: Team Juggernaut has sold its famous disk. Yes, that disk.

speaker: Jenna
text: Another loss for the former champ. It just can't buy a win.

speaker: Dale
text: Ooh. That's the old champ. Hard to watch.

speaker: Dale
text: Remember when it used to win? I do. I miss it.

speaker: Dale
text: Down again. Somebody give that robot a hug.

speaker: Chuck
text: That robot used to own this place, Dale.

speaker: Chuck
text: I know that look. You take a hit like that, you're never the same.

speaker: Chuck
text: Stay down, champ. Just stay down.

speaker: Vic
text: Once the king of the Box, rebuilt from scrap in an Oakland storage unit...

speaker: Vic
text: They sold the disk. They lost the sponsors. They kept the name...

speaker: Vic
text: Knocked out, counted out, written off... and still here. The former champion...

speaker: Vic
text: Bent, patched, and nowhere near finished... the fallen champion...

speaker: Vic
text: The cameras are rolling, the stands are filling up... welcome to the BotBox REGIONALS!

speaker: Vic
text: Prime time, ladies and gentlemen! Every seat is full, every camera is live... this is BOTBOX!

speaker: Vic
text: This is it! One Box, one Giant Nut, and one score to settle... the BotBox CHAMPIONSHIP!

speaker: Vic
text: In one square, the robot that fell. In the other, the robot that broke it. Two seasons in the making... this is the REMATCH!

speaker: Vic
text: From a storage unit in Oakland to the top of the world... the comeback is COMPLETE!

speaker: Dale
text: Well, well. The old champ still remembers how to do that.

speaker: Dale
text: Two seasons in a storage unit, and it still hits like the rent is due.

speaker: Dale
text: I missed that sound. I'm not crying, it's the smoke.

speaker: Dale
text: Okay, I take back what I said about this comeback. Most of it.

speaker: Chuck
text: THERE it is! The champ is BACK, baby!

speaker: Chuck
text: That's the Juggernaut I remember! Vintage!

speaker: Chuck
text: You can't teach that, Dale! That's muscle memory!

speaker: Chuck
text: The old champ's still got the arm! Still got the arm!

speaker: Jenna
text: Juggernaut wins again! Two seasons ago this robot was a box of scrap. How does this feel?

speaker: Jenna
text: I'm here with Team Juggernaut, and folks, the old champ is climbing! Talk to me!

speaker: Jenna
text: From a storage unit to the winner's circle! What's going through your head right now?

speaker: Jenna
text: This is the rematch everybody wanted. Juggernaut against the robot that broke it. Are you ready?
